headline: Revenue accelerates, margins expand, profit jumps
summary_short: F5 reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $865.1M, up 10.9% y/y and 6.6% q/q, with diluted EPS of $3.62, up 11.4% y/y and 40.3% q/q.
summary_long: Revenue reached $865.1M, up 10.9% y/y and 6.6% q/q. Gross margin was 82.2% of revenue, up roughly 128bp y/y and 84bp q/q, on gross profit of $711.5M (+12.6% y/y). Operating income of $213.3M rose 8.6% y/y. Diluted EPS of $3.62 rose 11.4% y/y and 40.3% q/q. Cash and equivalents grew to $1,605.8M, up 12.5% y/y and 11.3% q/q.
